title: Writing an actionable recommendation instead of an observation

videos.script: Read the last line of most analyses and you will find something like this. First deliveries are often late, and this may affect retention. {{line}} It is true. It is careful. And nobody can do anything with it. {{nothing}} It is an observation. It tells the reader what the analyst saw, and leaves the reader to decide what it means and what to do. {{observation}} A recommendation does those two steps for them. It says what to change, who changes it, by when, how much difference it should make, and how anybody will know. {{steps}} This lesson climbs from Marina's observation to her recommendation one rung at a time. It prices the options, puts a range on the effect, and ends with what to recommend when you are not sure. A test. {{test}}
